data.name: Anvil
data.description: Anvil Capture Systems is a CDR company focused on developing and scaling the CO2 mineralization reaction with alkaline-bearing ores, utilizing a proprietary low-energy reactor and feedstock preparation system. The Somerville, MA-based startup is a Greentown Labs member, received a Frontier prepurchase in Fall 2024, and was named an awardee of a Massachusetts state climate-tech grant program in 2025.
